title: AIWG Project Configuration
description: Configuration file for the AIWG AI coding assistant framework

scripts.description: Named scripts runnable via AIWG sidebar or CLI

remotes.description: Repo origin topology — declares primary (CI/issues/PRs) and secondary remotes (#994)

primary.description: git remote name driving CI/PRs by default. Defaults to 'origin' when absent.

issue_tracker.description: Where issues live. Defaults to primary.

ci.description: Where CI runs. Defaults to primary.

secondary.description: Mirrors, fork bases, and publishing targets

delivery.description: Repo control / delivery policy — how AIWG agents are expected to ship code (#995)

mode.description: How agents deliver code. direct = commit/push to default_branch; feature-branch = push branch, no PR; pr-required = branch + PR (default)

branch_naming.description: Branch-naming conventions. {issue} and {slug} are interpolated by skills.

prefix_by_type.description: Per commit-type branch prefix templates (feat, fix, docs, chore, refactor, test)

delete_branch_on_merge.description: Delete the feature branch after merge. Default true.

require_ci_green.description: Agent must wait for CI green before declaring done. Default true.

auto_close_issues.description: Include 'Closes #N' in PR body. Default true.

issue_comment_on_cycle.description: Post AL CYCLE status comments to issue threads. Default true.

parallelism.description: Provider-scoped parallelism caps — limits concurrent subagents, Ralph loops, and MC missions to keep AIWG within the rate-limit envelope of the underlying model provider (#1359). Composes (effective limit = MIN) with context-budget caps and rlm-context-management Rule 8.

max_parallel_subagents.description: Max concurrent subagents (Task dispatches, rlm-batch fan-outs). Default: provider-specific (claude=4, codex/copilot/etc.=10).

max_parallel_ralph_loops.description: Max concurrent Ralph external loops. Default: provider-specific (claude=2, others=3).

max_parallel_mc_missions.description: Max concurrent Mission Control missions. Default: provider-specific (claude=4, others=6).

rationale.description: Free-form note explaining why this cap was chosen (e.g., 'Claude Team plan API quota').

index.description: Artifact-index configuration — graph definitions (#1491). Consolidated here from the legacy .aiwg/config.yaml per ADR adr-index-config-consolidation.

graphs.description: Index graph definitions. Each key (except 'indices') is a JSON node/edge graph (IndexGraphDef); 'indices' holds the markdown-view manifest (IndexMarkdownIndices) rendered by corpus-index-build.

IndexGraphDef.description: A JSON node/edge index graph (mirrors GraphConfig in src/artifacts/types.ts).

type.description: Graph type identifier (defaults to the graph's key name).

scanDirs.description: Directories to scan, relative to project root (required).

shared.description: Whether the graph is shared across projects. Default false.

defaultBuild.description: Include in `aiwg index build` with no --graph. Default true.

filenamePattern.description: Named-capture regex for the filename-metadata strategy.

description.description: Human-facing note (metadata; not consumed by the builder).

IndexMarkdownIndices.description: Markdown-view manifest rendered by the corpus-index-build skill (build.py). The builder consumes each manifest entry's `name` (renderer selector) and optional `output`.

manifest.description: Ordered list of markdown views to render.

name.description: Renderer selector (by-topic, by-year, authors, by-venue, by-method, by-model-size, training-pipeline, citation-network, by-author, by-org, by-bridge, unprofiled-hubs).

SecondaryRemote.description: A non-primary git remote (mirror, upstream, publishing target)

name.description: Must match a name from `git remote`

push_on_release.description: Hint to release workflows to push tags here on stable cuts

InstalledFramework.description: Metadata for an installed AIWG framework

providers.description: Providers this framework was deployed to
